prompt: Create a hyper-premium cinematic frequency portrait of Mr.Tariq: a confident South Asian man shown from mid-thigh up, centered and facing the camera with arms crossed. He has thick tousled black hair, a full neat beard and mustache, medium warm skin, and wears black rectangular sunglasses with electric cobalt-blue reflective lenses. Dress him in a royal-blue crewneck sweatshirt with large metallic gold serif text reading “Mr.Tariq” across the chest, a burgundy collar peeking underneath, olive cargo pants, a gold wristwatch, and a gold ring. Behind him, place one massive circular halo-like portal made of brushed metallic gold with an inner deep-blue ring; the ring should glow with warm golden rim light and include subtle engraved text reading “PROMPTIFY AI” twice along the inner ring, one on the left curve and one on the right curve. Use a dark black studio background with a glossy wet floor reflecting the golden ring and the subject. Lighting should be dramatic and high-end: strong warm backlight from the circular ring, golden edge highlights on hair and shoulders, soft cinematic key light on the face, deep shadows, high contrast, premium editorial fashion photography, ultra-detailed fabric texture, realistic skin, sharp focus, 85mm lens look, shallow depth of field, vertical 3:4 composition. Keep the subject powerful, calm, and symmetrical, with no extra people, no extra text beyond the sweatshirt name and the two ring engravings.

promptZh: 创作一张超高端电影感频率肖像，主角为 Mr.Tariq：一位自信的南亚裔男士，半身构图，居中面对镜头，双臂交叉。他留着浓密凌乱的黑发、整洁的络腮胡和八字胡，肤色温暖适中，佩戴黑色长方形太阳镜，镜片为电钴蓝色反光材质。让他身穿一件宝蓝色圆领卫衣，胸前印有巨大的金属金色衬线字体“Mr.Tariq”，内搭露出酒红色领口，下身穿着橄榄色工装裤，佩戴金色手表和金戒指。在他身后，放置一个巨大的圆形光环状传送门，由拉丝金属金制成，内圈为深蓝色；光环应散发出温暖的金色轮廓光，内环两侧（左侧弧线和右侧弧线各一处）刻有细微的“PROMPTIFY AI”字样。使用深黑色摄影棚背景，地面为光亮湿润的质感，反射出金色光环和主体。灯光效果应具有戏剧性和高端感：来自圆形光环的强烈暖色背光，头发和肩部的金色边缘高光，面部柔和的电影感主光，深邃的阴影，高对比度，高端时尚摄影风格，超细腻的织物纹理，写实的皮肤质感，焦点清晰，85mm 镜头视觉，浅景深，3:4 竖构图。保持主体形象有力、冷静且对称，画面中不得出现多余人物，除卫衣文字和两个光环刻字外，不得包含任何额外文字。
